ratings.comment: Extremely caring about every student in class, Finn changed major parts of the syllabus to account for something that students wanted to spend more time and depth on and offered assistance the whole way.

Finn is a really awesome Professor. You can tell he is really passionate about what he is teaching, and he only cares that we learned. There was quite a bit of reading and many papers, but they tended to be open-ended and about graded very kindly.

Finn is a caring and great teacher, however, this class is poorly structured. There are 7 writing assignments that end up being 5-10 pages each. So much work and are graded with a single letter grade and no feedback. Lectures are basically unstructured with no slides, you have to write everything down that's said or there's no way to get it.

Finn is the most caring and impactful professor i've ever had. There are plenty of papers, but the feedback is helpful and they are very fair in their grading. I recommend doing the readings as consistently as you can, because all of the test material is specifics from the readings. Overall amazing class!

This class absolutely changed my life, Finn is a phenomenal professor. Because this class was a seminar, it was long, but so worth it. Reading responses were due each week, and we had to present what we wrote, so participation and reading was essential. If you put something into this class, you will get a lot back.

Finn is phenomenal. Although the lectures sometimes seemed to be unstructured at times, all the points Finn made came around and connected in the end. Finn is one of my few professors that I can say that I like and respect. I really hope to take another class with them one day. Papers and readings are long, but helpful and worth it.

Finn's Borderlands & Embodiment class is life-changing. She always values your views and assigns very readable books. Speaking up at discussion is essential. Despite heavy reading and writing workload, class never felt like a burden. One of the best classes you can take at the UW.

Finn is absolutely the best professor I've ever had. I've taken 2 classes with her now, both life-changing. I would definitely recommend her to anyone looking for new ways of thinking and to gain some self-insight. She's amazing.

Such an engaging lecturer. I had no prior knowledge or experience in the subject matter, but Finn's enthusiasm and passion was imparted to us all during lecture.Finn is definitely knowledgeable and can be considered an expert on the subject. Take a class with Finn at least once in your time here you won't regret it. Easy A!!!

all exams were take home essays, graded by TA though. amazing professor who truly cares about students and is so deeply interested in the material. my favorite class of the semester, would love to take another class with Finn!

History of Sexuality: This is a PhD-level class, and _a lot_ of work, but absolutely worth it. Prof. Enke did not speak much; the class ran the discussion. One benefit-students from all departments take this, so perspective were varied. Undergrad or grad--take a class with Enke before you graduate.

Finn Enke is spectacular. She facilitates excellent discussions, chooses awesome reading and produces innovative, original scholarship. She's well respected by students, staff and professors. Even if you think you have no interest in Gender/Sexuality studies and/or history, try not to graduate without taking a class or hearing her speak.

Anne was fantastic. History 275 is my favorite class I've taken at UW. She was so enthusiastic and extremely knowledgeable about the subject, and she's a very engaging lecturer. Class isn't terribly difficult, but it definitely takes some work. I wish I could take this class over again!

My course with Anne had about 20 students, we put our desks in a circle and spent the class discussing self-generated questions. Anne gave us guidance to have stimulating discussions. Class time flew by and I was always engaged. Weekly journals, 7 books, a few journal articles a week, final is a research paper or zine. Highly recommended.
Amazing professor and great class. Some reading but not anymore than a normal history course. Cheat sheet for tests.
Anne is great and knows a lot about what she teaches.  Classes were long and sort of boring but the class isn't too bad.

She's a great professor. I learned so much from this class and she was so passionate about the subject matter. We watched interesting videos and read interesting books. Tests were easy and she allowed a cheat sheet. Minimal homework. Overall highly recommended!
No Comments

Best. Class. I've. Ever. Taken. A lot of reading but EXTREMELY interesting. You WILL learn more in this class than any other class before. Tests/Essays are very very fair and we got to use cheat sheets for most of them! Very caring professor and very knowledgeable. Would love to take all of her classes!
Amazing Professor.  Anne's lectures are enlightening, engaging, and relaxed.  Her exams are fair, and papers are graded with a pink pen!    You wont be disappointed!

Amazing professor--I learned a ton and enjoyed myself while doing so. Lesbian Culture (442) required a ton of reading (a book a week often), attendance/participation was graded, 9 two-page papers on readings, and a fun final project. I will be taking more of her courses, and will continue to highly recommend her as a professor.

Anne is a fantastic professor. She keeps things clear, detailed and always interesting. Reading is not over-the-top and Ashley is an awesome TA. I would definitely recommend any class Anne teaches. You will walk away from it with an incredible amount of new knowledge and opinions. Tests are not hard. Go to class/discussion.

Anne is an excellent instructor -- very warm and informal with students, but also extremely knowledgeable and helpful.  The class (Women's Studies 442) had a lot of reading and a good amount of writing, but it was very good.
The best professor ever. What else can be said? She is amazing. You'll learn more than you ever thought and think in a new way.
